equation_comparison.locked_topology: two Queue(2, pipe=false, flow=false) stages in series
equation_comparison.valid_handshake: Equivalent for all reachable Queue(2) states after reset; full queues do not accept same-cycle replacement because pipe=false.
equation_comparison.unreachable_state: Target count is two bits and permits count=3 under unconstrained initial state; legal reset-reachable states are 0, 1, and 2.
equation_comparison.invalid_payload_difference: Locked output reads ram[deq_ptr] after each dequeue; target output remains data0. After a one-item enqueue/dequeue, valid=0 and the locked pointer reads the other slot while target still exposes the consumed item.

deterministic_model_check.method: Python source-level two-stage serial queue model comparison; no WSL/Yosys invocation
example_trace: observe out_a_valid=0: target retains 0x11; locked queue reads the other RAM slot

proof_contract_findings.finding: public payload bits are compared without valid gating
proof_contract_findings.impact: The 3+48+1 payload bits remain proof obligations when out_a_valid=0, where Decoupled does not define their value.

proof_contract_findings.finding: locked ram_2x132.sv has ENABLE_INITIAL_MEM_ removed in the trusted view
proof_contract_findings.impact: Reference memory contents are unconstrained before a write, while target Signal storage exports deterministic zero initialization.

proof_contract_findings.finding: target count encoding has unreachable count=3
proof_contract_findings.impact: equiv_induct -undef can enter a target state with no pointer/full counterpart.

recommended_minimal_fix.preferred: Change the partition miter to compare payload fields only when out_a_valid is asserted, or compare only ready/valid for this diagnostic partition, and document invalid payload as don't-care.
recommended_minimal_fix.exact_bit_level_option: Rewrite TwoEntryQueue with enqueue/dequeue pointers, maybe_full, and storage[deq_ptr] output to match Queue(2) invalid-cycle read timing; an initialization policy or valid-gated proof remains required because locked RAM is intentionally uninitialized.
